result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. However, it applies upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment and requires return and deletion of all Content and Customer data, which could disrupt unterminated Service Option Attachments. It also unnecessarily expands the requirement from Customer Data to all Content. The provision should limit its obligations to data associated with the terminated services, unless the entire Agreement terminates.
